title: Data
subtitle: What your data means, so agents answer questions about it correctly.
infoBody: A dictionary explains each table in plain words: what one row is, what the columns mean, how tables join and how metrics are counted. Agents only use approved versions. Anyone with access can suggest changes; the source's owner or an admin approves them.

list.emptyBody: Sites you add, and data shared with you, appear here.

detail.answersUse: Answers use this version · approved by {who}, {when}
detail.noneApproved: Nothing approved yet: agents answer from the table structure and say so.
detail.emptyBody: Use Build dictionary to have the agent study the tables and draft descriptions for you to approve.
detail.emptyBodyRead: The owner hasn't described these tables yet.
detail.driftTitle: The schema changed — {n} tables no longer match this dictionary
detail.driftTitleOne: The schema changed — 1 table no longer matches this dictionary
detail.driftHint: Answers may use outdated meanings until the owner updates them.

build.label: Build dictionary
build.hint: Opens a chat with the request filled in. Nothing starts until you press send.
build.prompt: Study the {source} data source and draft dictionary entries for the tables that aren't described yet. Ask me about anything unclear before proposing.

edit.title: Edit {table}
edit.hint: Your change goes into the draft. Answers keep using the approved version until the owner approves it.
edit.columnsHint: One column per line: name: what it means

history.title: History
history.restoreBody: Its text becomes the approved version again, saved as a new version. Nothing is lost: the current version stays in history.
history.restoreBlocked: Approve or discard the open draft before restoring an older version.

review.title: Review draft
review.noneBody: Suggested changes from chats, edits and studies collect here.
review.hint: Accept or reject each change, then approve. Rejected tables keep their approved text.
review.hintRead: Only the owner or an admin can approve. You can see what's waiting.
review.discardBody: All suggested changes in it are dropped. The approved version stays as it is.

share.title: Share dictionary
share.always: The owner and admins always have access. Sharing a dictionary doesn't show anyone rows they can't already see.
share.removeBody: They lose access to this dictionary straight away.
share.levels: Can read: see the approved dictionary. Can propose changes: also suggest edits for the owner to approve.
share.directoryError: Couldn't load the list of people, so you can't add anyone right now. Try again later; existing access is unchanged.

answer.noDictionary: Based on {source} · no approved dictionary yet
answer.saved: Saved as a suggested example. The owner will review it.
answer.correctHint: Tell the agent what's wrong in your next message. It will fix the answer and suggest a dictionary change for the owner to approve.
answer.undescribed: {tables} isn't described yet, so this answer is based only on column names. Ask the agent to describe it, and the owner approves the description under Data.
